external.description: Large language model (LLM) coding agents start each session with an empty context window, discarding accumulated knowledge from prior work. We present PrimeAgentOrchestrator (PAO), a system that spawns new instances of Claude Code -- Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent -- pre-loaded with relevant memories compiled from the user's existing personal databases. At spawn time, PAO queries two independently-operated memory backends in parallel (a PostgreSQL entity-observation database and a Cloudflare Worker semantic search index), fuses results using backend-specific retrieval strategies, and delivers the compiled briefing via filesystem injection that exploits the host agent's configuration auto-read behavior. PAO manages the full agent lifecycle including trust pre-seeding, readiness polling with error detection, and adaptive terminal text injection. We report on four months of regular deployment (December 2025 through March 2026) as an experience report, documenting three generations of context delivery mechanisms, the failure modes that motivated each redesign, and the engineering tradeoffs of bridging heterogeneous memory systems rather than building a unified one.
external.title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure

images.alt:
A vertical landscape photograph captures an intensely dramatic sunset above a quiet residential neighborhood. The sky dominates nearly the entire frame, filled with enormous layered clouds illuminated in brilliant shades of fiery orange, coral, red, and soft peach. Dark charcoal-gray cloud formations weave through the brighter areas, creating tremendous depth and texture. Near the horizon, the light becomes almost golden yellow, silhouetting rooftops, trees, utility poles, and overhead wires across the bottom of the scene. Dense leafy branches frame the image along the upper left and lower left edges, while a tall tree with a mixture of foliage and bare branching limbs rises along the right side. Two utility poles and several gently sagging wires cross the lower portion of the glowing sky, emphasizing the ordinary suburban setting beneath the extraordinary display overhead. The overall scene feels immense and luminous, with the turbulent clouds appearing almost like flames spreading across the evening sky.
